Net margin is net income divided by total net revenue, using the fiscal 2024 figures reported in the filings.

**JPMorgan Chase (2024):** net income $58,471M ÷ total net revenue $177,556M = 32.93%.

**Bank of America (2024):** net income $26,973M ÷ total revenue, net of interest expense, $105,856M = 25.48%.

Difference: 32.93% − 25.48% = 7.45 percentage points.

JPMorgan Chase had the higher net margin in fiscal 2024, by about 7.45 percentage points.
